description.value: Comor is a multi-sport outdoor retailer in Whistler specializing in bikes, ski, and snowboard gear, sales, and service. The Whistler location runs a dedicated bike shop with a full service and repair department, bike rentals, and a Retül 3D Motion Capture bike fitting service. They also host a Comor Cycling Club, making it a hub for both visiting and local cyclists.
